judgment.step0_observation: The player pushes three boxes onto four target locations in a small, symmetrical room. After a few moves, the player successfully covers all the targets.

creator_belief.reason: The puzzle is simple and symmetrical, lacking the clever tricks or narrative flow a human designer might add.

confidence_level.reason: The level is very basic, which could be an intro level by a human, but it feels more like a simple generation.

judgment.reasoning_for_creator_belief: The puzzle feels like a standard, uninspired Sokoban problem without any unique twists or personality.

enjoyment.reason: It's a very straightforward puzzle with little challenge, so there isn't much satisfaction in solving it.

difficulty.reason: The solution is immediately obvious and requires no real planning or thought to execute.

frustration.reason: There were no dead ends or difficult parts, so I never felt frustrated at all.

novelty.reason: This is one of the most basic box-pushing puzzle layouts possible; it feels very generic.

aesthetics.reason: The layout is clean and symmetrical, but also very plain and uninteresting to look at.
